historical_references.reference: Ferhat Pasha Sokolovic was a Bosnian Slav who converted to Islam and rose to prominence in the Ottoman Empire in the late 16th century. He served as the grand vizier of the Ottoman Empire under Sultan Murad III from 1579 to 1581, during which time he led the Ottoman army to a series of victories against the Austrian and Hungarian forces.

Ferhat Shah Josipovic was a Bosnian Muslim leader who led the defense of Bosnia against the Christian forces of the Habsburg Monarchy during the late 15th and early 16th centuries. He is best known for his successful defense of the city of Jajinci in 1463, which prevented the Habsburgs from capturing Bosnia.
